facts.claim: 凌晨四点半过后，她因时差再也睡不着，天还黑着就起床写作。
facts.quote: It was just after four thirty when I gave up on sleeping any longer

facts.claim: 她与 Luke Fulton 短信往来，得知他那边才五点半，因为亚利桑那不实行夏令时。
facts.quote: I’d forgotten that Arizona refuses to partake in daylight saving time

facts.claim: 两人随后把闲聊谈成安排，约定当天下午见面。
facts.quote: we made a plan to meet in the afternoon

facts.claim: 警车的闪灯打进窗来，她一看表还差四分钟七点，而当天最高气温将达九十二度。
facts.quote: I looked at the time. Four minutes to seven, eek.

facts.claim: 她换上黑色百褶裙与黑底白波点的船领泡泡袖上衣，脚穿系白缎带的凉鞋，匆匆下楼。
facts.quote: putting on a pleated dirndl skirt—black, of course—

facts.claim: 楼下空无一人，她仍按 Rose 的指点穿过房间走向通往庭院廊道的落地窗。
facts.quote: I followed Rose’s directions, crossing the room

facts.claim: 她绕过喷泉、钻过低垂的三角梅，悄悄靠近庭院中央，去看那名女警凝视的东西。
facts.quote: Tiptoeing around the fountain and beneath all that lovely bougainvillea

facts.claim: 躺在长椅上的正是 Deirdre Gregory：皮肤灰白、嘴角有干涸的呕吐物，眼睛再也不可能恢复生气。
facts.quote: there was no degree of rehabilitation that could reanimate them

relations.rel: Deirdre 是当年折磨 Genevieve 的人之一，刚获释，令 Genevieve 难以消化
relations.quote: Genevieve was struggling to process the release of one of her tormentors

relations.rel: 短信里比当面健谈，与她互有好感并约好当天下午碰面
relations.quote: he was chattier over text than in person

relations.rel: Dan 说过会报警，警察果然一早就到了
relations.quote: Dan had said he would call them, and here they were

relations.rel: Rose 给她指路，告诉她怎样从落地窗走到庭院廊道
当天上午唯一的会面对象，叙述者要为她写回忆录
relations.quote: my morning meeting with Genevieve was my only appointment of the day

relations.rel: 女警站在庭院中央，久久俯视着陈尸长椅的 Deirdre
relations.quote: The object of fascination was Deirdre Gregory.

numbers.claim: 前一晚她到午夜才上床睡觉
numbers.quote: despite going to bed at midnight

numbers.claim: 凌晨四点三十几分她放弃睡眠起床
numbers.quote: It was just after four thirty

numbers.claim: 她从二十世纪九十年代后期起就常泡咖啡馆写作
numbers.quote: as far back as the late 1990s

numbers.claim: 日出前还有一个多小时可供写作
numbers.quote: though I had well over an hour before this would happen
It was well past six by the time I looked up from my laptop

numbers.claim: 她自称已经起床两小时
numbers.quote: I’ve been up for two hours, I replied.

numbers.claim: Luke 所在时区当时是五点半
警车抵达时距七点还差四分钟
当天最高气温预报九十二华氏度
numbers.quote: the air temperature would peak at ninety-two degrees that day
The UV index was ten out of ten.

numbers.claim: 凉鞋的软木厚底替她增高约两英寸
numbers.quote: gave me a good two inches’ worth of extra height

numbers.claim: 几小时后她要去赴白天的约会
numbers.quote: for my daytime date in a few hours

numbers.claim: 太阳升起还不到一小时
numbers.quote: The sun had risen less than an hour before

numbers.claim: 中央走道旁共设两张长椅，她躺在其中一张上
numbers.quote: on one of the two benches placed along the central walkway

turning_point: 叙述者以为只是又一场寻常的早晨，却在庭院里发现昨夜被赶走的 Deirdre Gregory 已陈尸长椅——恶作剧式的骚扰骤然变成命案。
notes: 本章叙述者姓名未出现，一律记为“叙述者（I）”；Deirdre 的死因与凶手本章未交代；提到的凶案现场陈尸位置为中央走道旁两张长椅之一。
